request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Change only the colours: the red hooded shroud gown becomes a ragged near-black charcoal shroud with a thin bright violet trim along the hood's edge, the torn hem and the tail; her hair becomes pale warm ivory white; her face and hands become very pale ash grey with no blue; her eyes and open mouth glow bright violet and every small blue flame becomes bright violet. Keep the face, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
